page.title: Transaction bills
nav.label: Admin navigation
page.description: Download transaction bills for a completed date or month. Alipay supports daily and monthly bills; WeChat Pay supports daily bills only. Bills come from the payment provider. This site does not retain bill files or temporary download links.
form.order_help: Leave blank to use the current channel configuration. After changing merchants, enter the internal reference for an order from the previous merchant to query with its historical configuration snapshot.
error.bill_not_available: This bill is not available yet or has no transactions. Try again later.
error.bill_date_invalid: Choose a completed date or month within the last six years.
error.permission_denied: You do not have permission to download bills.
error.bill_query_failed: Alipay returned no usable bill. Check merchant permissions and try again.
error.bill_url_invalid: The payment provider returned an invalid download URL. The bill was rejected.
error.bill_file_invalid: The bill is missing, exceeds the size limit, or failed integrity verification.
error.wechat_bill_date_invalid: WeChat Pay supports completed daily bills only.
error.wechat_bill_metadata_invalid: WeChat Pay bill metadata failed verification.
error.bill_download_failed: The bill download did not complete. Fetch it again.
error.bill_host_unavailable: The bill service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error.generic: The bill was not downloaded. Refresh the page and check before retrying.
error.content_type: The bill file format is invalid.
